services.name: Garden Tours
services.desc: This article originally appeared in the Summer 2026 Napa Valley Chapter CNPS newsletter. On Sunday, May 17, I welcomed over 100 garden enthusiasts to my garden, which was one of 12 Napa gardens selected to be part of the 2026 Climate-Friendly Garden Tour. The Tour is organized every year by the City of Napa Water Department and the Napa Resource Conservation District (Napa RCD), and supported by the Napa County UC Master Gardeners and many volunteers. The Tour highlights gardens that are water-wise and drought-tolerant, build healthy soils, and encourage pollinators, all with a variety of landscape designs and in different settings.
